# Path rules of the configurator page tests (.github/scripts/ci_changes.py
# prints ui=true when a changed path matches one). The page tests run on the
# configurator's front end and server, the PC tools' modules it imports, the
# schemas, the shipped examples, the page tests and their data, and the
# shared CI files. One fnmatch pattern per line on the repository path, where
# * also matches /.

tools/deploy/canworks/*
schema/*
examples/*
tools/deploy/tests/*
.github/*
